title: MartinHopkinsLdlTable
description: Reference data, schema 1: web/public/data/martin-hopkins-ldl-table.json. The Martin/Hopkins 180-cell median TG:VLDL-C factor table (Martin SS et al 2013 JAMA 310(19):2061-2068) the `ldlmh` computed index (indexDefs.ts) looks up, keyed by triglyceride strata (rows) and non-HDL-C strata (columns), both mg/dL. App-internal data transcribed from a published source with no outside authors, so the objects are CLOSED, as in analytes-1.schema.json and pathway-reference-ranges-1.schema.json.

nonHdlBands.description: The 6 non-HDL-C column strata, in table order (<100 ... >=220).

rows.description: The 30 triglyceride row strata, in table order (7-49 ... 400-13975), each carrying its 6 non-HDL-C-column factors.

band.title: NonHdlBand
band.description: One non-HDL-C column stratum, mg/dL, inclusive bounds. The first band omits `low` (open below, '<100'); the last omits `high` (open above, '>=220').

row.title: Row
row.description: One triglyceride row stratum, mg/dL, inclusive bounds, with its 6 median TG:VLDL-C factors in nonHdlBands column order.

retrieved.description: Required. ISO date the quoted text was retrieved from `url`.
